ticket_fee_notice: Why is there a fee on my ticket? We're proud to call the Mountain View Center for the Performing Arts home. Like many venues, MVCPA adds fees to each ticket: a $ facility fee and a $4 processing fee. These are set and collected by the venue, not PYT. We want you to know the full cost up front, so there are not surprises at checkout. Thank you for supporting our youngs artists!
title: Shows
auditions_body: PYT casts its shows through open auditions throughout the year. No experience required — everyone is welcome.
